title.narrative: NESA Center Pakistan National Defence University Visit 01-22

description.narrative: The NESA Center hosted Pakistan's National Defence University in Washington DC. The objectives of the event are for the participants to become more familiar with: the United States National Security planning apparatus; organization of Professional Military Education Programs in the United States; organization of the National Defense University; role and purpose of the Near East South Asia Regional Center; basic security issues of concern to the United States; and South Asia World Bank programs. There were also interactions between the Department of State, Department of Defense, and Homeland Security.

title.narrative: NESA Center Pakistan Media, Academia and Security Workshop 01-22

description.narrative: NESA Center and Jinnah Institute hosted a day long workshop on "Media, Academia and Security" with three major sessions focusing on best practices for media and academia to cover security policy (both domestic and external). The workshop framework will be built around security sector reform & creating space for public-private partnerships in security domain. Selected 12 to 15 participants from media (covering security) and academia (security studies) from Islamabad, Lahore and Karachi. Six panelists (two addressing each panel) will be leading experts from major media, universities and government sector (police and military). From NESA, Dr. Hassan Abbas will be cohost/lead of the event alongside Jinnah Institute's Mr. Salman Zaidi. Keynote talk will be delivered by Federal Minister and former Pakistan ambassador to US, Sherry Rahman. Jinnah Institute will publish a report on the subject for which the 6 panelists will contribute essays. The report will be a joint Jinnah Institute-NESA report on best practices for journalists and academics on how to cover/research sensitive topics.
